body:
1st pic  could be “SEEL” , “Seal” as in Arweave “Seal of permanence “.    You have a C and looks to be a L top left and right and the letters look like eyes so -   C eye eye L could be SEAL or SEEL

Also look closely, that’s not ANHO, it’s a “r” or “i” then a “i” and “o” = ario

Second pic - black line and white line could be BYTE ,   Black = B and white = YTE as in saying Y and adding te is white.   The white arrow has a 1 in it, could be to add, 21874 divided by 24 hours is 911 days. idk 

3rd pic i think is GPUS because there is a p and a couple u’s in there with the pickaxe 
  
5th pic is Norway and Sweden there is no Denmark.  It looks like an airplane with the letters d v and a 8.  So could be “node” as in  
“no de-nmark”  or dv8 as in deviate from path. Also could be ARGO as in C-argo for plane 

Also i’ve noticed that pic 5 goes into pic 2 and the diamond is on a road with lines - as in a “give way sign, road sign”

 6th pic. the tree has a clock in it, hands and dials. It also has eyes. And a fork in it.  the branch that looks sawed off “that’s called a fork”   There’s also letters in the tree, K,O, F,R , Y, H U, U maybe uu is “w” Also there’s a “tree of life” - funny because it’s actually in the Genesis book 2:9  

7th pic- cactus also has letters D, E, T or V, A, O and the number 4 also it’s shaped like a 4 also.   and L’s everywhere maybe upDATE or URL’s . i see the U and L’s but no R. Also the D is in the P and a D at bottom of cactus. Could be load as in upload or download. the bottom left L could be a boot. “ saguaro boot” made from holes in cacti. 

8th pic is tricky.  The dots spell something if you connect them. I cant get it figured out yet. Turning the pic all different ways i see the letters. If you’re on a phone have it flat at almost eye level and slowly turn it. There’s also an arrow pointing back at the cactus. And they look like a few of them are coins and funny but when you count the dots do you poke them? lmao as in Poke a dot or polk-a-dot. 

So another thing that i’ve tried is that the pics go in pairs. So for example 4th and 8th pic i tried Mint for 7 and base for 8 = mint base or basement 

Sorry for the long rant but i’ve been working on this so long. Another weird thing is it could all be AR** as in ARGO, ARNS, but not all have AR apps or whatever.  I went back and read the news from that time. another thing is it could be abbreviations for coding. example is data, logs, init, TXID, post, JSON, HTML.
